Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LXXXIX OF 1996
ORDINANCE LXXXIX OF 1996
TAX ADJUSTMENTS ORDINANCE, 1996
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Tax Adjustments Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall, come into force at once.

Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944), in the First Schedule, in the table
under Chapter 98 and heading "Services", in the first column, after
the heading 9816.0000 and the entries relating thereto in the second and third
columns, the following new heading and the entries relating thereto shall be
added, namely:‑‑

Amendment of Act IV of 1969

ORDINANCE LXXXIX OF 1996
ORDINANCE LXXXIX OF 1996
TAX ADJUSTMENTS ORDINANCE, 1996
3. Amendment of Act IV of 1969.‑‑In the Customs Act, 1969
(IV of 1969), after section 18A, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:‑‑
"18B. Levy of service charge ‑‑‑The
Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, levy a service
charge equivalent to two per cent. ad valorem on all such goods specified in
the First Schedule to this Act as are subject to pre‑shipment inspection:
Provided that for the purposes of Sales Tax Act,
1990, such service charge shall not constitute a part of the value of supply.
".
